spans.s:
m. (-यः)
A prince of the solar race.
f. (-यी)
The daughter of the preceding, and one of the wives of DAŚARATHA: the mother of BHARATA: see केकेयी.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Squint-eyed.
E.
के in the head, कृ to make, टच् affix; also compounded with अक्ष an eye, as केकराक्ष.

f. (-का)
The cry of a peacock.
E.
के an imitative sound, and क what sounds, from के to sound, affixes ड and टाप्.

m. (-लः)
A peacock.
E.
केका his cry, and बलच् aff.

m. (-की)
A peacock.
E.
केका the cry of the bird, and इनि aff.

f. (-यी)
One of DAŚARATHA'S three wives, the mother of BHARATA.
